_doc: Per-scene mobile (portrait) framing for encode_frames.py. Default: centre crop to 9:16. 'fit': crop columns x0..x1 at full height, place at center_y, fill above/below. 'points' are frame positions (0..1) whose mobile position the encoder prints, e.g. for web glow origins. Optional 'q_d' / 'q_m': WebP quality for this scene, a number or "lossless" (default 100). Hosting decision 2026-11-16: lossy q100 everywhere except s01 desktop (lossless, dense city lights).
